Shiraz AI specializes in deploying robots that learn new manufacturing tasks from a single human demonstration. Their main product offerings include a robotic foundation model designed for industrial automation, particularly in contract manufacturing environments where production lines frequently change.
: The robots can learn tasks from just one demonstration provided by a human, which eliminates the need for extensive programming or CAD designs.
: The foundation model adapts to the specific context of the task without requiring retraining or additional data collection, making it highly flexible.
: Shiraz AI provides a complete solution that includes the hardware, the learning model, and on-site deployment support, addressing the challenges faced in high-mix manufacturing scenarios.

The benefits of these features include increased efficiency in manufacturing processes, reduced costs associated with traditional automation, and the ability to quickly adapt to changing production needs.
